text: Hello and welcome to the live commentary of the Premier League clash between Tottenham and Manchester United at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Tottenham kicked off the campaign with a 2-2 draw against Brentford in their opener last week.
Cristian Romero headed Ange Postecoglou's men in front before the Bees struck twice to turn the game on its head.
But, Emerson Royal scored a fine effort to earn his team a share of the spoils.
Spurs now need to up the level of their game against United, having proven that they can score goals without Harry Kane.
Manchester United edged out Wolves in their opener courtesy of Raphael Varane's second-half effort.
The Red Devils were far from convincing and survived a late penalty scare after Andre Onana wiped out Saka Kalajdzic in the box.
The decision went United's way and Erik ten Hag was delighted to see his team get off the mark with a win.
Spurs will present a challenge on the road, and Ten Hag will want to correct his side's poor away record against top-half teams from last season.
Spurs have made two changes to their side from their draw against Brentford.
Porro gets the nod to start at right-back ahead of Emerson, who drops to the bench.
Sarr comes into the middle of the park to replace Skipp.
Romero is cleared to play after suffering a head injury after scoring the opener against the Bees last time out.
Manchester United have named an unchanged side from their win over Wolves.
Martinez was forced off half-time with an ankle problem, but returns to the fold to start alongside Varane.
Rashford continues to lead the line with Garnacho and Antony in the final third.
Martial remains on the bench, while Harry Maguire has failed to make the squad.
Spurs have won just one of their last nine Premier League games against Man Utd (D2 L6), and are winless in five against them (D1 L4) since a 6-1 away win in October 2020.
We're under way at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Kulusevski angles a deep cross to the back post for an unmarked Son.
The Spurs captain tries to take on a first-time strike, but he scuffs his attempt well away from goal.
OVER! Porro loses possession and Garnacho offloads back to Antony for a first-time strike at goal, but he lifts his strike over the bar.
SAVE! Garnacho surges down the left flank and cuts inside to shoot on his right foot.
But, his effort is tame and Vicario produces a routine stop.
Fernandes is down for the visitors after battling for possession with Porro.
He receives treatment on the pitch.
Antony sends a switch to the left flank to release Garnacho.
He runs into the box and offloads to Shaw on the overlap, but Porro tracks the run and sends the ball behind for a corner.
Mount swings a corner in from the right flank deep to the back post.
Varane challenges for the header, only to send his effort over the top.
Spurs have been sloppy in possession in the early stages of the game.
United have been able to create turnovers, but have not put Vicario under tremendous pressure
SAVE! Antony releases Rashford into the Spurs box and he surges past Romero.
The England international tries to lift his strike over Vicario, but the Spurs keeper spreads himself to make an important block.
BLOCK! United cut Spurs open at the back as Rashford finds Wan-Bissaka.
He sends a cutback to Garnacho to strike, but his effort is charged down by Romero.
Sarr gets a turnover in the middle of the park and releases Kulusevski down the right flank.
He drives all the way to the byline and wins a corner.
Kulusevski runs at the United defence down the right flank and Martinez has to get across to block his cutback behind for a corner.
Maddison fails to find his range from his second corner after hitting the first one short he sends his second out of the box.
Casemiro brings down Bissouma on a forward run and hands Spurs a free-kick in a useful position.
Maddison fails to beat the first man with his delivery, wasting another promising position for the home side.
Rashford makes a good run into the inside-right channel to latch onto Fernandes' pass, but Van de Ven blocks his effort at goal.
Onana launches a perfect cross-field pass to Garnacho on the left flank.
He has space and time, but he fails to pick out a team-mate in the middle.
Fernandes produces a sensational rabona cross to find Rashford six yards out, but he places his header over the bar.
The forward would have been just offside anyway, but he wasn't aware.
Shaw raids down the left flank and cuts the ball back to Fernandes, but Sarr makes an important block for the hosts.
SAVE! Spurs counter down the left flank as Son beats Varane all ends up.
The Frenchman is fortunate not to give away a free-kick as Son stays up and offloads to Sarr.
He in turn feeds Kulusevski to strike, only to see his effort saved by Onana.
Rashford surges past Van de Ven with ease down the right flank and offloads to Garnacho.
It deflects wide off Romero, but there is an instant appeal for handball.
VAR will look at this.
Romero breathes a sigh of relief as the referee points for a corner.
That could have gone either way.
SAVE! Spurs break with speed through Maddison.
He finds Udogie and then Son takes over before sliding a perfect throughball for Sarr on a late run.
The midfielder shoots first-time and sees his effort saved by Onana and is then closed down before he can turn the rebound home.
Wan-Bissaka prevents Spurs from taking a quick free-kick and goes into the book.
CHANCE! FERNANDES HAS TO SCORE! Shaw clips a perfect cross into the box for an unmarked Fernandes to attack in the middle.
He only has to place his header on target to score, but he plants it wide of the left post.
Unlike Rashford, he was onside.
Antony clips Bissouma on the charge and goes into the book.
Fernandes appeals the decision by referee Michael Oliver and follows his team-mate into the book.
OFF THE BAR AND POST! Spurs hit the woodwork twice within 10 seconds.
Son tees up Porro to strike from inside the box and he beats the hand of Onana, but rattles the bar.
Sarr gathers the rebound in the inside-right channel and his cutback is deflected onto the post by Shaw.
The rebound falls inches away from Richarlison allowing United to clear.
Spurs have found their rhythm and are ending the first half on the front foot.
United will be determined to get into the break without conceding here.
Kulusevski steps inside on his left foot to shoot from 25 yards, but Onana watches it all the way into his hands.
Porro makes a run to the byline and whips a cross into the middle for Romero to attack.
But, he can only loop his header into the arms of Onana despite the presence of Richarlison.
There will be three minutes of added time.
Fernandes stands a cross into the middle, but it glances off the top of his head on its way behind for a goal-kick.
HALF-TIME: TOTTENHAM 0-0 MANCHESTER UNITED
It's goalless at the break in the Premier League clash between Tottenham and Manchester United.
Spurs came the closest to breaking the deadlock when Pedro Porro rattled the bar with a strike and Pape Sarr's cross from the rebound was deflected onto the post.

At the other end, Bruno Fernandes should have at least hit the target with a close-range header, while United could have had a penalty for a handball by Cristian Romero which was not given after a VAR check.
The contest remains in the balance at the interval.
Ange Postecoglou will be pleased with his side's response after United made a strong start to the game.
Once Spurs found their rhythm they began to create chances, but could not find the elusive breakthrough.
The second half could be vital for both teams as they look to set the tone for the campaign ahead.
We're back under way at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Wan-Bissaka makes a vital interception to cut out a pass from Maddison towards Son.
The Spurs captain would have been through on goal there.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!! SARR FIRES SPURS IN FRONT!!!!!!! 1-0!!!!! Sarr gambles with a late run in the box and is in the right spot to convert Kulusevski's deflected cross.
Kulusevski is afforded acres of space down the right flank and he breaks to the byline.
He sends a right-footed ball across the face of goal which falls kindly for Sarr, and he makes no mistake hooking his left-footed strike into the net.
OFF THE POST! United should be level, but Antony's left-footed strike rattles the left post.
Fernandes wins possession in the final third and slices open the Spurs defence with a pass to Antony.
He cuts inside past Van de Ven and shoots, only to be denied by the post.
SAVE! Spurs go back up the other end and Onana has to be alert at the near post to repel a low strike from Udogie following good build-up work from Son.
Romero goes down under pressure from Martinez and then Maddison goes down in the penalty area under Antony's challenge.
But, the referee is unmoved amid Spurs' appeals for a penalty.
Udogie brings down Rashford on the charge down the right flank, handing United a free-kick in a decent position.
WHAT A STOP! Vicario produces a brilliant one-handed save to deny Casemiro.
Fernandes puts a dangerous cross into the middle for the Brazilian to attack.
He connects sweetly with his header, but Vicario reacts to turn it over the bar.
Wan-Bissaka makes a vital challenge as the last man on the half-way line to stop Kulusevski.
The Spurs man remains down after the tackle and receives treatment.
Fernandes is played behind the Spurs defence by Shaw and fires at goal.
Vicario produces another fine save to turn his effort past the post, although the flag goes up late for offside.
Kulusevski cuts in from the right flank and shapes to shoot.
He opts against the strike and feeds Bissouma, who fires wide of the target.
BLOCK! Shaw has to put his body on the line to block Son's strike after brilliant work in combination between the Spurs captain and Udogie.
Udogie holds the ball after bringing down Antony and is booked by the referee.
WIDE! Bissouma continues to cause problems for United.
He weaves his way inside the box and shapes to shoot, but he places his left-footed strike past the post.
Garnacho is withdrawn for Sancho by Ten Hag.
Wan-Bissaka makes way for Dalot at right-back, which might due to his booking in the first half.
Eriksen gets a warm reception from the Spurs fans as he replaces Antony.
United have had to weather a storm from Spurs in the second half.
Had Antony's strike hit the back of the net rather than the post it could have been a different story.
But, they need to find to conjure an equaliser from somewhere.
Davies replaces Udogie for the hosts at left-back.
Perisic shores up the left side of Tottenham's line-up as he replaces Richarlison.
Son will push up front.
Eriksen slips amid pressure from Kulusevski, but the loose ball falls to Varane and deflects behind for a Tottenham corner.
Perisic cuts in from the left flank and delivers a threatening cross to the back post where Shaw does well to head clear with Kulusevski lurking.
Hojbjerg replaces the goalscorer Sarr in the Tottenham midfield for the closing stages.
Rashford has a run at Porro down the left flank, but the defender does well to hold his ground and win the ball.
Davies tries to feed Kulusevski in the inside-left channel, but just overhits his throughball out for a goal-kick.
Casemiro latches on to a clearance on the edge of the box and launches a strike on the half-volley that Vicario watches into his hands.

GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!! MARTINEZ DEFLECTS THE BALL INTO HIS OWN THE NET!!!!!!! 2-0 TOTTENHAM!!!! Tottenham extend their lead as Davies' scuff takes a massive deflection off Martinez and rolls into the bottom-right corner.
Perisic does well down the left flank as he cuts inside on his right foot and curls a cross into the middle.
Davies does not connect well with his strike and it benefits the hosts as it travels onto Martinez's boot on its way past Onana.
Rashfords cuts a frustrated figure as he is replaced by Martial.
Pellistri is on for Mount in the final third.
Martial works the ball towards Fernandes, who shoots on the turn from 25 yards, but his effort is charged down by a wall of white shirts.
Emerson replaces Porro for the closing stages of the game at right-back.
Solomon enters the action for Kulusevski, who has been excellent today.
Pellistri has a run at Davies down the right flank and gets to the byline before he goes down amid contact from the defender.
The referee is not interested in United's appeal for a penalty and neither is VAR.
There will be nine minutes of added time.
Fernandes lines up a curling strike from 25 yards, but Vicario watches it all the way into his hands.
Spurs will want to see this game out with a clean sheet.
Spurs pile forward into the final third in search of another goal.
Maddison takes possession, but sees his strike charged down.
Casemiro angles a cross deep to the back post, only to send his delivery over the head of Pellistri.
Shaw drives forward from left-back and offloads to Casemiro on the stretch, but his effort is deflected over the top.
Vicario makes another super stop to deny United by turning Varane's header onto the bar.
The offside flag has gone up late anyway, but the Spurs goalkeeper has put forward a fine display in front of his new supporters.
Bissouma brings down Pellistri on the edge of the box, handing United a chance to get a consolation goal from the resulting free-kick.
OVER! Fernandes takes the set-piece, but curls his effort over the bar.
The United captain is not happy with himself.
FULL-TIME: TOTTENHAM 2-0 MANCHESTER UNITED
Tottenham secure their first win of the Premier League season by defeating Manchester United for the first time since October 2020.
Pape Sarr notched his first goal for the club to put the home side ahead just after the interval.
Lisandro Martinez then deflected Ben Davies' scuffed strike into his own his net to hand Ange Postecoglou his first victory in the Tottenham dugout.
United had a couple of moments and can look back at Antony's effort that rattled the post just after Sarr's opener, but they were largely second best at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Tottenham are next in action against Bournemouth on the road next Saturday.
United are at home to Nottingham Forest on the same day.
Thanks for joining our commentary today.
Until next time, goodbye.
